theorem bounded_chart_count (A : ℝ) {B : Set Position} (hB : Bornology.IsBounded B) :
    ∃ C > 0, ∀ n : ℕ, 1 ≤ n →
      (relevantLabels n A B).Finite ∧
        ((relevantLabels n A B).ncard : ℝ) ≤ C * ChartScales.S n ^ 9
